meta.name: The Superior Human?
meta.description: The myth that humans are superior to all other life forms is a fundamental and unquestioned premise of dominant culture. It is an old historical idea, rooted in colonialism, and is deeply embedded in religion and science. It is one of the root causes for the destruction of the natural world, animal cruelty, war, the extinction of species and other immense problems.The Superior Human?challenges this arrogant and self-destructive ideology; unwinds the myths, using examples and common sense.
